hypothesis: The reduced-denominator LCM used by V5_RECENT_DENOMINATOR is always a divisor of the hidden previous-1/3/5-appearance workload but is exact only about 82-83% of the time. A target-free auxiliary classifier trained on reconstructed historical appearance sizes can identify the missing integer multiplier and recover materially better recent workload and reliability features without using another evaluation row.

source_protocol.auxiliary_label: true previous 1/3/5 pitcher-appearance pitch totals reconstructed from official historical train row order
source_protocol.history_cutoff: season strictly before the source validation year
source_protocol.training_profile: leave-one-appearance-out pitcher and pitcher-by-game-type workload profile inside completed history
source_protocol.validation_profile: all completed-history appearances, frozen before the validation year
source_protocol.validation_input: one representative row per pitcher appearance; only current-row recent-rate values, pitcher/game-type identity, and frozen workload profile
source_protocol.ranking: fixed classifier only; no target-score tuning
source_protocol.on_fail: Close without reading 2022+ decoder labels or any control-success metric.
source_protocol.on_pass: Freeze the decoder and preregister one exact-C downstream feature ablation before reading control-success metrics.

row_local: six official previous-1/3/5-game success and middle rates
LCM lower denominator, decoded counts, nested differences, and ambiguity flags
frozen_profile: pitcher appearance count, mean, standard deviation, and 25/50/75 percentiles
pitcher-by-game-type appearance count, mean, standard deviation, and 25/50/75 percentiles
league appearance mean and standard deviation
features.forbidden_current_context: inning, count, row order, and changing career counts are excluded so every row in one appearance receives the same decoded workload

model.decision: modal multiplier class; if a class was unseen during fit it cannot be selected
